ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 8
   C. 24.5
   D. 7

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

3. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27
   D. 27.6

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 21
   C. 90
   D. 42

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

9. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 7

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 66
   C. 17
   D. 22

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 30
   C. 45
   D. 36

15. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

18. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 37

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 22
   C. 28
   D. 33

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 15
   C. 44
   D. 22

21. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12.5
   C. 25
   D. 6

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 19

23. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 49
   C. 43
   D. 31

24. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 9
   C. 12
   D. 21
